stem: What is an important difference between Jonny's invention and Ann's invention?

options.label: A
options.text: Jonny's invention needs energy to function, while Ann's offers a way to conserve energy.

options.label: B
options.text: Jonny's invention can be used by anyone, while Ann's requires supervision before it can be used.

options.label: C
options.text: Jonny's invention is used to improve another machine, while Ann's is used on its own.

options.label: D
options.text: Jonny's invention was immediately successful, while Ann's had to be redesigned.
